classes.label: Letter A
classes.description: Make a fist with your dominant hand, thumb resting on the side.

classes.label: Letter B
classes.description: Hold your hand open with fingers straight together and thumb tucked across the palm.

classes.label: Letter L
classes.description: Extend your index finger and thumb at a 90-degree angle, like an 'L' shape.

classes.label: Letter V
classes.description: Extend your index and middle fingers in a 'V' shape, with the other fingers closed.

classes.label: Letter Y
classes.description: Extend your thumb and pinky finger, keeping the middle, ring, and index fingers closed.
